notes: 40 prompts (30 generate incl. 2 deliberately vague, 5 edit, 5 from_pine) + 5 adversarial. 'expect' lists objective checks on the resulting spec (see strategy_lab/ai/evaluation.py); intent is also scored by an LLM judge. Pine sources live in evals/pine/.

items.prompt: Go long BTC on the 4-hour chart when the 20 EMA crosses above the 50 EMA; exit when it crosses back below. Use a 1.5% stop loss.
RSI(14) mean reversion on BTC 15-minute bars: buy when RSI drops below 30 and exit when RSI rises above 55. Long only, stop at 2 ATR.
Short BTC when the hourly close breaks below the lower band of a 20-bar Donchian channel and cover when it closes back above the middle band. 3% stop.
Bollinger Band (20, 2) mean reversion on BTC 5-minute bars: buy when price closes below the lower band, sell short when it closes above the upper band, and exit at the middle band.
Trade gold on the 1-hour chart: go long when the MACD line crosses above its signal line while price is above the 200 EMA; exit on the opposite MACD cross. 1% stop and 2% take profit.
Breakout on BTC daily bars: buy when the close exceeds the highest high of the previous 55 days. Manage the trade with a 3 ATR trailing stop and a 4 ATR initial stop.

BTC 1h directional movement system: long when ADX is above 25 and +DI is above -DI, short when ADX is above 25 and -DI is above +DI. Exit when ADX falls below 20. 2 ATR stop and a 2:1 reward-to-risk target.
Fade extreme funding on BTC: when the funding rate is above 0.05% per 8 hours go short, when it is below -0.03% go long. Use the 1h chart, hold for at most 24 hours, 4% stop.

Gold London-session breakout on 15-minute bars: between 07:00 and 10:00 UTC, go long when price breaks above the highest high of the last 16 bars. At most one trade per day, exit after 8 hours, 0.5% stop.
Stochastic oversold bounce on BTC 4h: buy when %K crosses above %D while both are below 20. Exit when %K goes above 80. 5% stop.
BTC 15-minute VWAP reversion: go short when price is stretched more than 1% above the session VWAP and cover when it returns to VWAP. 1% stop.

Hull moving average trend on BTC hourly: go long while HMA(21) is rising (above its value one bar earlier) and exit when it turns down. Size each trade at 10% of equity with 2x leverage and a 2.5% stop.
Keltner channel pullback on BTC 1h in an uptrend: when price is above the 100 EMA and dips to the lower Keltner band (20, 2), buy. Exit at the upper band. Stop 1.5 ATR.
CCI(20) on BTC 4h: go long when CCI crosses above -100 and short when it crosses below +100. Exit longs when CCI is above 100 and shorts when it is below -100. 3% stop, 6% target.
Rate-of-change momentum on BTC daily: buy when the 10-day ROC is above 5% and exit when it drops below 0. Fixed $5,000 position at 3x leverage with an 8% stop.
Volume confirmation on BTC 1h: long when on-balance volume is above its value 20 bars ago and the close is above the 50 SMA. Exit when the close drops below the 50 SMA. 2 ATR stop.
Short-only BTC 5-minute scalper: short when RSI(7) crosses below 70 and the close is below VWAP. Take profit 0.4%, stop 0.3%, at most 10 trades a day and wait 3 bars after each exit.
Triple EMA alignment on BTC 1h: long when EMA 8 > EMA 21 > EMA 55, short when EMA 8 < EMA 21 < EMA 55, and exit when that order breaks. 2 ATR stop.
Use the 4-hour 200 EMA as a trend filter and enter on 15-minute RSI pullbacks: long when the 15m RSI(14) crosses back above 40 and price is above the 4h 200 EMA. Stop 1.5 ATR, target 3 ATR.
Gold daily: buy when price closes above the upper Bollinger band (20, 2.5) and sell when it closes below the middle band. Use a 2% trailing stop and a 4% initial stop.
On the BTC hourly chart, go long at the 00:00 UTC bar and exit after 6 hours, but only on days when price is above the 20-day SMA (computed on daily bars). 3% stop.
BTC 15m: buy after three consecutive closes below the 20-period weighted moving average, exit when the close gets back above it. Long only, 1% stop.
Test the classic 50/200 SMA golden cross on BTC daily, long only, with the lighter_premium fee profile and a 10% stop. Exit on the death cross.
Buy BTC 4h breakouts above the highest high of the last 20 bars. Put the stop below the lowest low of the last 10 bars with a 0.2% buffer and take profit at 3R.
Ignore funding and slippage for this one: a BTC 1h RSI(2) strategy that buys when RSI(2) is below 10 and exits when it is above 90. 3% stop.
Gold 4h trend breakout: go long when the close crosses above the upper Keltner band (20, 1.5) and ADX(14) is above 20; exit when the close falls below the Keltner middle line. 2 ATR stop.
BTC 1h: go long when the 9 EMA crosses above the 21 EMA, but only during US hours (13:00 to 20:00 UTC). Exit on the reverse cross. 1.5% stop, 3% target.
BTC 4h MACD histogram flip: long when the histogram turns positive, short when it turns negative. 2.5 ATR stop and no fixed target.
Make me a strategy that buys the dip.
items.answers: Bitcoin on the 1 hour chart, long only. A dip means RSI(14) below 30; exit when RSI is back above 50. Use a 2% stop.
